PDF Multi-level Grid Strategies for Ray Tracing
Abstract: Grids have some of the lowest ray tracing acceleration structure build times. This is because acceleration structure construction is analogous to a sorting algorithm. The ideal behavior for a sorting algorithm is to have O(N) time complexity regarding the number of elements.
